parsed.summary: The PR resolves the pickling issue by replacing weak references with strong references in the Grouper class. The change is minimal and focused.

issues.description: The new PicklableGrouper class uses strong references instead of weak references, which may have implications for memory management and could potentially lead to memory leaks if not handled carefully.
